The plate is only partly visible, with cucumber slices and some ham or meat at the top. Judging from the curvature, the plate is likely a side plate of about 22-24 cm.

The visible cucumber is about 6-7 spears or slices, roughly 120 g. The ham is a couple of slices, perhaps 40 g.

Cucumber is about 15 kcal per 100 g, so 120 g gives about 18 kcal. Ham is about 110 kcal per 100 g, so 40 g gives about 45 kcal. Together that is about 65 kcal. Some of the plate may be hidden, so I'll round up slightly to about 160 g and 70 kcal.
